note: The parts this project added, in the shape the Design System artifact wants: publish components/ into the release's project/components/.

components.name: Menu
components.summary: A list of choices on its own surface: a filter, a sort, a set of actions, anchored to the thing it belongs to.

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: The one place Iris interrupts: a decision that cannot wait, with the action that matters first.

components.name: Sheet
components.summary: Secondary content anchored to an edge: the bottom on a phone, the side on a wide window.

components.name: Snackbar
components.summary: What happened next, next to the thing it happened to: one line and at most one action.

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: The name of a thing that is only an icon, on hover and on focus.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: A count or a dot on the thing it belongs to: a tab, an icon, a word.

components.name: Slider
components.summary: One value on a line: how much, how far, how loud.

components.name: TextArea
components.summary: The multi-line field: a note, a message, anything longer than a line.

components.name: Select
components.summary: One choice out of a few, in the shape of the fields around it.

components.name: SearchField
components.summary: Finding something: a pill field that says what it is doing and clears itself.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: A few angles on one thing, under its title, with the ink sliding to the active one.

components.name: Steps
components.summary: Where you are in a short flow, and what is still coming.

components.name: EmptyState
components.summary: Nothing here yet, said properly: what this place is for and the one thing to do about it.

components.name: Toolbar
components.summary: A bar of actions that belong together, docked in a screen or floating over the content.

components.name: DatePicker
components.summary: A month you pick a day in: one accent on the chosen day, today marked with a ring.

components.name: TimePicker
components.summary: A time you set with two strips: the hour, then the minute. The chosen time reads big, in mono.

components.name: AppBar
components.summary: The top line of a screen or a window: what this is, and the few actions that belong to it.

components.name: NavRail
components.summary: The wide-window version of the tab bar: a rail of sections that collapses to icons.

components.name: SplitButton
components.summary: One action, and the caret that opens the others that belong to it.

components.name: Carousel
components.summary: A strip of cards you swipe or scroll sideways, with dots that say where you are.

components.name: Mark
components.summary: Her ring as a still, sharp mark, from the brand kit's 1024px render with its glow. For a logo, a lock screen, an empty page.

components.name: Edge
components.summary: The apps' light patterns along an edge: round her orb while she thinks, along a screen while it reloads. The TalkOrb and the Orb3D think with it.

components.name: EdgeText
components.summary: A word as a neon sign: the Edge light runs along the outline of every letter. SVG and CSS only.

components.name: Divider
components.summary: A hairline that groups what is above it from what is below.

components.name: CircleStack
components.summary: Every chat with its loops as a circle, stacked behind the strip: where the loops live now that the iPhone app has no Loops tab.

components.name: LoopBubble
components.summary: One loop, small: its first letter in a disc and the six phases round it, the current one lit.

components.name: Photo
components.summary: A photo with a depth map: a word behind the person, duotone in the topic's colours, or parallax in four depth layers. No photo ships: without a src it paints its own neutral scene with a matching depth map, and without a depth map it guesses one (lower and central is nearer).

components.name: BorderPattern
components.summary: A pattern running along a rounded edge, one per moment: refreshing, listening, thinking, working, speaking, a question waiting, news, saving.

components.name: ChatStack
components.summary: Every chat with its loops as a card in its topic's colour, stacked with depth; a tap fans them out, a tap on one opens that chat with its loops and actions.

components.name: MacPill
components.summary: Iris on the Mac desktop: her orb, a bar of buttons that grows out from behind it, her words above and one state line under it.

components.name: VaultAsk
components.summary: The vault's question, the same on every device: who asks, from where, why, what it does and how far it reaches, then allow or no.

components.name: TableApp
components.summary: A list you search, filter and open: search in the AppBar, filter chips, the rows on one Card, a count line, a row that opens a Sheet.

components.name: Gauge
components.summary: The release's Stat with a meter under it: one number, its word, and how full it is.

components.name: Bars
components.summary: Rows that say which one is the biggest: a name, a bar, the number, biggest first.

components.name: Days
components.summary: One column per day, oldest left, the last one bright: a count over a fortnight.
